item.title: CVE-2026-136433 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.0: 7.8
item.description:
Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.0: 7.8 | PyTorch Foundation PyTorch torch_save_to_dcp Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of PyTorch Foundation PyTorch. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.
The specific flaw exists within the checkpoint format conversion utilities. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user. Was ZDI-CAN-32834.

item.title: CVE-2026-136434 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.0: 9.8
item.description:
Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.0: 9.8 | Super Magic PHPSandbox Command Injection Sandbox Escape Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass the sandbox on affected installations of Super Magic. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the PHPSandbox endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute PHP code. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escape the sandbox and execute arbitrary code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-28102.

item.title: CVE-2026-136440 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.0: 7.3
item.description:
Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.0: 7.3 | Python Packaging Authority pip Configuration File Incorrect Permission Assignment Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Python Packaging Authority pip. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. User interaction on the part of a target user is also required.
The specific flaw exists within the way configuration files are stored. The issue results from incorrect permissions on files. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of a target user. Was ZDI-CAN-25377.

item.title: CVE-2026-136441 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.0: 9.8
item.description:
Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.0: 9.8 | Bytebase DBHub MCP Incorrect Authorization Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Bytebase DBHub. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the MCP server. The issue results from an incorrect authorization decision when parsing untrusted SQL. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-27635.

item.title: CVE-2026-136442 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.0: 6.5
item.description:
Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.0: 6.5 | BusyBox ftpd Directory Traversal Arbitrary File Read and Write Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create or delete arbitrary files or disclose sensitive information on affected installations of BusyBox. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the ftpd service, which listens on TCP port 21 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create or delete files or disclose information in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-27555.

item.title: CVE-2026-135799 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.0
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.0 | A vulnerability was detected in flowable flowable-engine 8.0.0. item.title: CVE-2026-136328 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.8
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.8 | A flaw was found in the file-psd plugin in GIMP. When processing a specially crafted PSD (Photoshop Document) image file in LAB color mode, the plugin does not properly validate that a fourth channel is present when the transparency flag is set. This mismatch causes the merged-image path to allocate buffers for three components while performing color conversion with four-component formats, resulting in a heap-based buffer overflow. This issue can result in an application crash, leading to a denial of service, or potentially allow for arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-136452 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | browser-use before 1.0.0 contains a URL parser differential vulnerability in SecurityWatchdog that allows attackers to bypass allowed_domains, prohibited_domains, and block_ip_addresses checks by crafting a URL with a backslash before the allowed host, exploiting the mismatch between urllib.parse hostname extraction and Chromium's WHATWG-style URL parsing. Attackers can influence an LLM-controlled navigate action, such as through prompt injection, to send requests to loopback or private addresses or arbitrary external hosts before the browser redirects to about:blank, enabling SSRF and persistent state changes on the target server.

item.title: CVE-2026-136453 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | browser-use before 1.0.0 contains an allowlist bypass vulnerability in the SecurityWatchdog's _is_url_match function that allows attackers to bypass domain restrictions by exploiting a raw-string startswith() comparison instead of parsed hostname validation. Attackers can craft URLs using userinfo injection or domain prefix confusion (e.g..com@attacker.com or .com.attacker.com) to redirect an LLM-controlled navigation to an arbitrary host, exfiltrating sensitive data such as secrets embedded in the URL to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

item.title: CVE-2026-136455 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | borg-ui before 2.4.1 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows a repository-scoped operator to escalate to full administrator by exploiting an unrestricted source_directories field in the backup-plan API that lacks path allow-listing. Attackers can configure a backup plan to archive the application's data directory, download the resulting archive to extract the static HS256 .secret_key, and use it to forge a JWT with sub":"admin" to access admin-only endpoints like GET /api/auth/users, achieving full application takeover without admin credentials, XSS, or CSRF.
